method: After reviewing every daily-reading annotation, inspect the fourteen remaining exact point sites in high-note BEL1:27 as a complete unit. Literal pointed/plain WIS pairs, filled SUS47, nearby BEL Daniel40 narrow-neck point and local plain yods establish the comparison without assuming grammar. Three other yod sites retain heavy continuous bodies without a uniquely added node. Seven initial-vav vowels and the bet/kaf vowels remain too coalesced to eliminate competing point classes. Same-letter literal bet/kaf and detached lower-vowel controls are archived for those retentions. A pinhole is not required where complete added-node contour is diagnostic, but opaque mass is insufficient. All BEL targets and local BEL controls use the lower Theodotion body only; no upper Septuagint substitution. No OCR, AI enhancement, expected spelling, translation, modern vocalization or asserted new-scan independence supplies marks. All99 durable PNGs exactly replayed against six freshly extracted original PDF images.
